response.justification: While the candidate demonstrates 20 years of solid engineering experience and over a year of AI-agent infrastructure exposure at re:cinq, they lack the core qualifications for this director-level strategic role. The infrastructure-focused AI work (tooling, frameworks, MCP) does not establish the demonstrated AI/ML domain expertise or strategic product experience required. A principal engineer in AI strategy must advise customers on technology adoption and lead strategic cloud/AI initiatives—capabilities this candidate has not demonstrated. The role explicitly requires recognized AI expertise with built platforms; this candidate has strong engineering fundamentals but lacks the specialized AI knowledge base needed.
strengths: 20 years of full-stack engineering experience across diverse platforms (web, mobile, desktop, infrastructure) demonstrating technical adaptability and breadth
Over 16 months of hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure, MCP frameworks, and agentic workflows at current role showing emerging AI engagement
Proven entrepreneurial leadership as GISCollective founder and strong mentorship capability demonstrated through technical workshops and educational initiatives
concerns: No demonstrated expertise in AI/ML domain knowledge, machine learning platforms, or AI-powered products—the primary specialization required for this strategic role
AI experience is infrastructure-focused (tooling and frameworks) rather than strategic, product-focused, or customer-advisory in nature
Lacks advanced degree in AI field and no evidence of director-level strategic leadership, enterprise technical advisory, or AI strategy track record

key_factors.factor: Strong Engineering Foundation with Emerging AI Infrastructure Experience
No Strategic Leadership or Customer Advisory Track Record
